title: Write a value that may be nothing
objective: Declare a value that may be missing, using the ? form or the or nothing form of its type.

body.text: A value that might be missing has an option type. Write of type followed by the kind, then a question mark, such as of type text?. You can also write the same thing as of type a text or nothing. Both mean the value is either a text or nothing.

body.title: Two ways to write it
body.code:
make name equal to nothing of type text?
say name

make score equal to nothing of type a number or nothing
say score

make scores equal to a list of 42
make first score equal to first of scores
say first score

body.text: Use is nothing or is something to check the value before you rely on it, as in the handle a missing value lesson.

body.prompt: The program declares score with the ? shorthand. Rewrite it the other way this lesson shows, using or nothing, and keep it printing nothing.
body.starter:
make score equal to nothing of type number?
say score
body.solution:
make score equal to nothing of type a number or nothing
say score

checks.description: It uses the or nothing form
checks.matches: of type a number or nothing
